tagline.en: BMW's 210 hp, 303 km/h superbike for road and track

summary.en: The S 1000 RR is BMW Motorrad's flagship superbike. Its 999 cc ShiftCam inline-four makes 210 hp, it weighs 198 kg ready to ride, and it reaches 100 km/h in about 3.2 seconds. Track-derived parts like winglets, M brake ducts and Race ABS come from BMW's World Superbike programme.

desc.en: Water/oil-cooled four-cylinder with titanium valves and BMW ShiftCam variable intake timing. Makes 210 hp (154 kW) at 13,750 rpm and 113 Nm at 11,000 rpm. The cast-aluminium bridge frame wraps around it and uses the engine as a load-bearing part.
Cast-aluminium twin-spar bridge frame with a bolt-on rear subframe. It wraps over the engine, which acts as a stressed member, and carries the steering head, swingarm pivot and seat.
Curved water radiator mounted ahead of the engine behind the front fairing, fed by the fairing's air ducts. Keeps the four-cylinder at working temperature on track and in traffic.
Collects the four header pipes under the engine and runs them to a short side silencer, with a closed-loop catalytic converter to meet EU5+ emissions.
Holds 16.5 litres of fuel, with about 4 litres in reserve. Its shape gives the rider's knees and chest a place to tuck in at speed.
The rider's seat sits 832 mm off the ground (858 mm with the sport seat). The slim tail unit hides the rear subframe and tail light.
The nose cone cuts through the air and holds the LED headlights. Newer RRs add winglets to the side panels for extra front-end downforce.
A tall, curved screen that pushes the airflow over the rider's helmet when tucked in on a straight. Top speed is 303 km/h.
Low clip-on handlebars, the throttle and brake levers, and the colour TFT dashboard that shows riding modes like Rain, Road, Dynamic and Race.
Side panels that smooth the airflow around the engine and channel cooling air to and from the radiator.
Fully adjustable front suspension with 120 mm of travel. Its steering head angle is 66.4°, set for quick, precise turn-in.
A 17-inch cast-aluminium wheel with a 120/70 tyre and twin 320 mm discs gripped by four-piston fixed calipers, backed by Race ABS.
A wide 6-inch rim with a 190/55 ZR17 tyre to put the power down, plus a single 220 mm rear disc.
An aluminium swingarm with BMW's Full Floater Pro rear suspension: 118 mm of travel with adjustable preload, rebound and compression.
A 525 chain with 17/46 sprockets carries power from the six-speed straight-cut gearbox to the rear wheel.

note.en: Rendered from a third-party 3D model. Labels describe the real current S 1000 RR; the model is not an exact replica.
